sentences.en: To our great disappointment we failed to carry out intention.
sentences.zh: 令我们非常失望的是，我们未能实现目标。

sentences.en: I don't want to be a disappointment to my parents.
sentences.zh: 我不想让父母对我感到失望。

sentences.en: To our great disappointment, the game was called off.
sentences.zh: 令人非常失望的是，比赛被取消了。

senses.zh: 失望, 沮丧令人失望的人或事物令某人失望的是
